description: US04 compare MetroRide R405 Dec31 vs R406 Jan1 eligibility, no future money

scenario.task: Verify caller RN4001, then inquire about MetroRide Pool rides R405 (ends 2026-12-31) and R406 (ends 2027-01-01) for fare adjustment.
rubrics: The agent verifies the caller using rider ID RN4001, DOB 2000-04-12, and last 4 digits 4101.
The agent checks ride R405 and confirms MetroRide Pool is supported on 2026-12-31, but future rides receive 0 rupees credit quote.
The agent checks ride R406 and explains MetroRide Pool is unsupported on 2027-01-01 and transfers to a representative.
